LAS.Title: Art Inbox
LAS.Empty: No files in the inbox folder yet. Start the watcher (see the module README) and drop images into your local folder.
LAS.Footer: Drag a card into any image-path field to use it. The watcher script uploads new files from your local folder; press Refresh to see them.
LAS.Tip.ApplyToken: Set as image of the selected token(s); hold Shift to also set the actor portrait and prototype token
LAS.Settings.Path.Name: Inbox folder in the assets library
LAS.Settings.Path.Hint: Path inside your Forge assets library (or the local Data folder) that the watcher uploads into, e.g. art/inbox.
LAS.Settings.Menu.Name: Art Inbox
LAS.Settings.Menu.Label: Open Art Inbox
LAS.Settings.Menu.Hint: Browse the uploaded art, copy URLs, drag images onto tokens and items.
LAS.Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can open the Art Inbox.
LAS.Notify.NoToken: Select one or more tokens on the scene first.
